name: Sense CMS X Publisher
author: QUANT Software House Limited
description: Publishes reviewed Sense CMS posts to connected X accounts through the X API v2.

changelog.summary: Validate post payloads before refreshing OAuth credentials.
Close the OAuth window after return even when the provider has isolated it from the opener.
Connect multiple X accounts with OAuth 2.0 PKCE and publish reviewed link posts through X API v2.
